closedFindings.reason: The final capped byte/end check now follows the suffix write, F_FULLFSYNC and the parent's directory barrier. It reads the no-follow reopened object after matching its device and inode to the held written handle, and the entire buffer/read cost is reserved before the first effect.

evidence.purpose: Read-back cost is included in the whole C-SUFFIX reservation.
At most four positioned reads into a buffer of expected length plus one; only observed EOF returns Some.
Reservation precedes ACL append/write; both barriers and identity confirmation precede final byte/end verification.
Private and ACL-omitted cases refuse with one edge or one byte short before mutation; exact limits cover the final confirmation.
Post-barrier changed, longer, shorter, failed, unended and intact cases exercise final confirmation; native capped reader cases cover EOF/full buffer/empty.

assessment.finalConfirmation: Production complete_private_suffix delegates to the private implementation with read_back_capped. The early platform verification remains unchanged, but completion now also requires post-barrier expected bytes and EOF on the confirmed reopened inode. A full buffer, short/different bytes or no EOF within four calls returns Confirm; read I/O returns ConfirmIo.
assessment.reservation: suffix_readback_cost checks expected length plus one and adds one object, four edges and that buffer size. suffix_cost includes it in the reservation taken by work.effect before C-ACL or the suffix write. post.spend occurs before allocating or reading. Exact limits and one-edge/one-byte-short limits cover both private and omitted-ACL inputs.
assessment.regression: The private read-back seam is bound to the native capped reader in production. The regression changes content or length at the final confirmation point after both native barriers, injects read failure/no end, and verifies intact same-inode success and native reader cap outcomes. This closes the specific pre-barrier-only gap.
assessment.delta: Reconstructing r1 against 1d24900 and applying the pinned r1-to-r2 patch reproduces every current subject file exactly. Only private_access.rs differs from r1, limited to C-SUFFIX final confirmation, its private helper and its tests. Platform write_new_regular/write_regular_suffix, C-ACL, P-PREFIX, RW-P1/P2/P3 uses, typed results and scopes are unchanged.
